subject: Technical walkthrough — missed session & next steps
messages:
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@aureus.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T16:12:00Z
Subject: Technical walkthrough — missed session & next steps

Hi Nora,

We missed you on today's technical walkthrough (scheduled for 11:00 AM PST). Ben and Karthik were on the call to cover the integration surface and deployment timeline. No worries — things happen.

Quick summary of what we prepared: short demo of inference latency improvements, the sandbox we built for your dataset, and a rollout checklist for dedicated capacity. Attaching a condensed agenda we planned to use.

Can you share whether you ran into a calendar or access issue, or should we assume the window still works for you and propose alternate times? If helpful, here are three compact slots we can offer for a 30-minute condensed session:

- Tue 12/08 10:00–10:30 AM PST
- Wed 12/09 2:00–2:30 PM PST
- Thu 12/10 9:00–9:30 AM PST

Ben, Karthik — if we get a reschedule, can we run the condensed agenda (attached) and prioritize the sandbox walkthrough + KV cache behavior?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: condensed-agenda.pdf (1 page, agenda summary)

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T16:28:00Z
Subject: RE: Technical walkthrough — missed session & next steps

Ben / Karthik — quick internal note (keeping Nora on the loop above):

Observed no-shows lately usually come from either timezone mixups or Zoom link problems. If Nora doesn't reply by EOD, I recommend:

- Run the compact 30-min agenda (attached) as our canary path. Avoid deep quantization talk unless they ask.
- Offer a sandbox access link they can try before the call (we have a hosted token-limited sandbox).
- If they confirm a slot, please prepare a 10-minute measurement screen share and a single-slide rollout checklist.

Also, flag any procurement/licensing blockers up front so we can cover them quickly during the 30-minute slot.

Laura

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Nora Patel <nora.patel@aureus.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T18:03:00Z
Subject: RE: Technical walkthrough — missed session & next steps

Thanks Laura — copying the condensed agenda below and proposing two additional evening-friendly slots in case their team is on the East Coast:

Proposed 30-min slots (add to Laura's list):
- Tue 12/08 6:00–6:30 PM PST (9:00 PM EST)
- Wed 12/09 5:00–5:30 PM PST (8:00 PM EST)

Condensed 30-min runbook (what I'll cover):
1) 5min — Quick intro & success criteria
2) 10min — Live sandbox walkthrough: latency/throughput on their sample prompt set
3) 10min — KV cache and batching behavior demo (impact on cost)
4) 5min — Next steps: sandbox access, pilot sizing, and procurement timeline

Attachment: condensed-agenda.pdf (one-slide summary)

If you confirm a slot I will prepare a sandbox token and a 3-point measurement checklist. Nora — we can also drop a short sandbox instruction file in the thread so your infra person can try access ahead of time.

—Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Nora Patel <nora.patel@aureus.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T20:11:00Z
Subject: RE: Technical walkthrough — missed session & next steps

Adding a couple PM items to surface during the condensed session if they rebook:

- Licensing question: whether they need inference-only consumption (hosted API) or dedicated capacity. If they say "pilot" we should default to hosted with a path to Dedicated.
- Data controls: confirm if any HIPAA-level requirements (if so, loop security/PS).
- Success metrics: target latency percentile and cost per 1k tokens.

If Nora confirms a slot, I can draft a one-page mutual action plan we can finalize in the follow-up.

Karthik Iyer
Product Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@aureus.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-06T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Technical walkthrough — missed session & next steps

Hi Laura — so sorry for the no-show. We had an internal all-hands push and I lost the slot. Thanks for reaching back out and for the compact agenda.

The Wed 12/09 2:00–2:30 PM PST slot from your first list works for me. Can you please:

- Send a sandbox access link and short instructions I can forward to our infra engineer (cc Samir Shah <samir.shah@aureus.ai>).
- Keep the session focused on the sandbox walkthrough and KV cache behavior — procurement/license discussion can be short.

If you prefer evening slots, I can ask Samir, but the Wed afternoon time is ideal for our PM/SE to join.

Thanks,
Nora Patel
Head of Platform, Aureus Labs
nora.patel@aureus.ai
